content:
Sam: Quick design check — I pushed a sketch for the new flow-ordering editor. Can we do a 15m review? Trying to lock copy + validation behavior before dev cycle.
Anika: Linking the Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz — focus areas: 1) priority sorting UI, 2) validation states, 3) preview output.
Maya: I can join in 10. One quick note: the current sort handle feels tiny on touch.
Liam: For preview simulation, we can reuse the existing routing simulator backend but we need a stable deterministic seed for order tests.
Sam: good — for copy I'm worried "fallback to secondary" vs "use fallback model" ambiguity. Want short, explicit phrasing.
Anika: Agreed. Proposal: primary label = "Priority (higher first)", action label = "On match: Route to" and the fallback row shows "If no match: fallback to". Short and consistent.
Psalm: Accessibility nit: the priority control needs clear aria-labels and keyboard ordering. Also color contrast on the badge is 2.9:1 right now.
Kai: Noted. We can increase contrast and add aria-label="priority handle". Might need to bump the badge weight.
Maya: UX question: if validation fails (overlapping ranges / contradictory rules), do we block save or allow save with warnings?
Anika: Let's follow the pattern we use elsewhere — inline blockers for structural breakage (e.g., two rules with identical match + priority), and non-blocking warnings for heuristics (e.g., rule may be shadowed).
Sam: Example validations we need in UI copy: 1) "Duplicate rule — adjust priority or conditions" 2) "Rule will never match — consider removing" 3) "Circular fallback detected"
Anika: Draft copy (short):
```
Duplicate rule detected. Change priority or conditions to continue.
This rule will never match any request.
Circular fallback found — please fix the fallback chain.
```
Maya: For blockers we should show an inline red pill and disable Save. For warnings show a yellow chevron and let Save proceed with confirmation toast: "Saved with warnings — view issues".
Liam: Backend side: we return a diagnostics array with severity {ERROR, WARNING, INFO} and a suggested fix token. So UI should map ERROR -> block, WARNING -> allow + toast, INFO -> inspector only.
Sam: Perfect. For the preview panel: UX wants a side-by-side example request -> route path. Can we surface the matched rule ID and explain which condition matched?
Anika: I mocked a compact panel: left column sample request toggles, middle shows rule list with highlight, right shows routing trace. Toggle: "Show matched condition" (on/off).
Maya: Implementation question: highlighting in the list when preview picks a rule — should it auto-scroll? Auto-scroll is fine but animated scroll could be jarring. Suggest instant scroll + subtle pulse.
Psalm: Keyboard users: ensure preview toggles are reachable and that the highlighted rule receives focus when selected. Also add aria-live region for diagnostics so screen readers get immediate feedback on validation changes.
Kai: We'll add aria-live="polite" for diagnostics and call focus to the matched rule element. Can defer animations for reduced-motion setting.
Sam: Small copy tweak: current placeholder says "Add rule..." — change to "Add routing rule" to avoid ambiguity with product rules vs infra rules.
Anika: +1. Also change tooltip text for priority handle to "Drag to reorder priority — top runs first".
Maya: One more nit: empty-state for preview should encourage sample inputs: "Try example request" button with 3 presets (chat, embedding, rerank).
Liam: We'll provide example payloads; simulator will run them without hitting production models by using cached deterministic responses.
Sam: Timing: can we finalize copy + ARIA by EOD? I can merge the copy doc into the spec.
Anika: I'll update Figma with the final copy and link.
Psalm: I'll run a quick contrast check and keyboard flow tonight. Will post any blockers.
Maya: I'll prototype the scroll+focus behavior Friday morning.
Kai: I'll stub the aria-live + focus behavior in the simulator endpoint this afternoon.
Sam: Thanks everyone — quick action items: Anika update Figma, Psalm do a11y checks, Maya implement scroll mock, Kai backend stub. Meeting if needed at 11:10am. :thumbsup:
ui-bot: @here New comment added by Anika on the Figma file: "Updated copy and added preview trace"
Sam: Received — will review before EOD.
